description: Third-person references like 'yeah alex from the product team' should not trigger the bot now that 3rd-person filtering is stricter.

events.speaker: John
events.text: so we talked to the product team yesterday

events.speaker: Sarah
events.text: yeah alex from the product team said he will handle the integration
events.comment: This should not trigger because it is clearly about another person named Alex
Third-person filtering should suppress the false positive
